case_name: Kumari M Mythri vs Sri R Muniraju

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Kumari M Mythri, minor represented by her mother and guardian Smt. A'Nalida.
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri R Muniraju, aged about 55 years.

facts_of_case: Petitioner is a minor seeking permission to alienate property in favour of intending purchaser.

legal_principles.principle: A guardian of a Hindu minor has the power to do what is necessary for the benefit of the minor, but not to prejudice the rights of the minor.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the guardian of a Hindu minor has the power to do what is necessary for the benefit of the minor, but not to prejudice the rights of the minor.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 8

legal_principles.principle: A court shall not grant permission to a guardian to do any act under Section 8 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act except in cases of necessity or evident advantage of the minor.
legal_principles.held: No court shall grant permission to a guardian to do any of the acts mentioned in subsection (2) except in cases of necessity or for the evident advantage of the minor.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act — Section 8

outcome.final_order: Permission granted to the father and natural guardian of the petitioner to alienate the property in favour of the intending purchaser.
